messages:
mike: quick ping — PR #4823 is ready for release cut but needs a quick review. small changelog + backport note. cutting window in ~2h, can someone eyeball?
jen: on it, linking the PR now. do we need a backport to 1.12-stable? what about the migration script?
sam: I reviewed the logic earlier, looks fine. one nit on variable naming, but not release-blocking. I'll approve once CI green.
alex: I can do changelog wording — currently says 'misc fixes', can we make it clearer?
maria: +1 to sam. for changelog propose: "Fix: reduce latency on prefix cache eviction; backport to 1.12" — covers it.
mike: thanks — here's the changelog snippet I'm planning to paste:
```
Fix: reduce prefix cache eviction thrashing which reduced tail latency under burst load.
Note: backported to v1.12 for Dedicated customers.
```
jen: looks good. CI status?
ci-bot: PR #4823 — checks queued. build: pending, unit-tests: running, e2e: failed (flaky-test-17). See: https://ci.example.com/4823
sam: e2e failed on a known flake, not related to this change (timeout in test harness). I'll re-run the job.
jen: re-run requested. @sam can you also add a short test skip comment so we don't block the cut?
sam: re-run done. unit-tests passed, e2e retried — now passed.
ci-bot: PR #4823 — all checks passed.
alex: approved. left one tiny doc nit but not blocking.
mike: @jen @sam @alex thanks. can someone add the backport label and tag for the cut?
jen: adding labels: `backport/v1.12`, `release/cut-2026-03-17`, `changelog-ready` :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Noted for cut queue. Priority: high. Will attempt merge during the next safe window.
maria: quick FYI — remember to not squash merge, keep commit history for the backport cherry-pick.
mike: got it. merging once release-bot reports merge window open. thanks all :rocket:
release-bot: Merge window opens at 1798457005. Attempting merge when safe.
release-bot: Merge of PR #4823 succeeded and added to release branch. Cut queue updated.
jen: thanks team! :tada:
sam: nice and smooth — cheers.
